_meta.release: ServiceNow Brazil public docs plus SDK table metadata
notes: Choice labels are documented; numeric or string values not shown in the docs are inferred (see the Basis columns in the markdown specs).
Choices with inactive=true are legacy values kept for imports and REST writes.

Tables with extendsExisting=true exist in the SDK schema: fields lists only columns missing from the SDK, overrides lists dictionary overrides. Other tables are new; overrides there are dictionary overrides of inherited task columns.

Shared tables owned by sibling specs are not redefined here: task_ci, task_cmdb_ci_service, task_service_offering (cmdb.md), dl_u_priority (platform-core.md), kb_template_known_error_article, kb_template_incident_kcs_article, m2m_kb_task (knowledge.md).
Priority 3/3 = 5 follows the platform data lookup and problem pages; the incident priority page sample shows 4.
incident_task has no own numbering and inherits task (TASK prefix).

kpis.name: Mean time to resolve
kpis.formula: avg(closed_at - opened_at) over incidents closed on D

kpis.name: Average resolution time of resolved incidents
kpis.formula: sum(hours(resolved_at - opened_at)) / (count(resolved on D) * 24)

kpis.name: Average close time of incidents
kpis.formula: sum(hours(closed_at - opened_at)) / (count(closed on D) * 24)

kpis.name: % first assignment resolution
kpis.formula: count(resolved on D and reassignment_count = 0) / count(resolved on D) * 100

kpis.name: First contact resolution (ResolvrNow)
kpis.formula: count(resolved on D and reassignment_count = 0 and resolved_by = opened_by) / count(resolved on D) * 100

kpis.name: % resolved same day opened
kpis.formula: count(resolved and date(resolved_at) = date(opened_at)) / count(resolved) * 100

kpis.name: % reopened
kpis.formula: count(reopened_time in period) / count(resolved_at in period) * 100

kpis.name: % breached SLAs
kpis.formula: count(closed on D with any task_sla.has_breached) / count(closed on D) * 100

kpis.name: Number of open incidents
kpis.formula: count(resolved_at is empty) at end of D

kpis.name: Incident backlog growth
kpis.formula: count(opened on D) - count(resolved on D)

kpis.name: Average age of open incidents
kpis.formula: sum(hours(now - opened_at) over open) / (count(open) * 24)

kpis.name: % of new critical incidents
kpis.formula: count(opened on D and priority = 1) / count(opened on D) * 100

kpis.name: % of open incidents reassigned at least once
kpis.formula: count(open and reassignment_count > 0) / count(open) * 100

kpis.name: % of incidents closed by self-service
kpis.formula: count(closed and close_code in closeCodeSets.selfService) / count(closed) * 100

kpis.name: % of incidents not solved
kpis.formula: count(closed and close_code in closeCodeSets.notSolved) / count(closed) * 100

kpis.name: Self-solved percentage
kpis.formula: (self_solved_va + self_solved_kb + self_solved_qna + self_solved_proactive + automated_resolutions) / (total_ticket_resolutions + self_solved_va + self_solved_kb + self_solved_qna + self_solved_proactive + password_reset_self_service) * 100

kpis.name: Call deflection
kpis.formula: (catalog_submissions + va_submissions + self_solved_va + self_solved_kb) / (total_tickets_submitted + self_solved_va + self_solved_kb) * 100

kpis.name: Mean time to identify (major incidents)
kpis.formula: avg(first proposal or promotion time - min(first alert created, opened_at)) over MIs accepted on D

kpis.name: Number of open problems
kpis.formula: count(opened_at <= D and closed_at is empty)

kpis.name: Problem backlog growth
kpis.formula: count(opened on D) - count(closed on D)

kpis.name: Average age of open problems
kpis.formula: sum(hours(now - opened_at) over open) / count(open) / 24

kpis.name: Average close time of problems
kpis.formula: sum(hours(closed_at - opened_at) over closed on D) / count(closed on D) / 24

kpis.name: % of open problems classified as known error
kpis.formula: count(open and known_error = true) / count(open) * 100

kpis.name: % of open problems with at least one incident
kpis.formula: count(open and related_incidents > 0) / count(open) * 100

kpis.name: % of problems closed on first assignment
kpis.formula: count(closed and reassignment_count = 0) / count(closed) * 100

kpis.name: % of closed problems without any close notes
kpis.formula: count(closed and close_notes is empty) / count(closed) * 100

kpis.name: % of new critical problems
kpis.formula: count(opened on D and priority = 1) / count(opened on D) * 100
